title: Xanthe and the Atlas
author: Cyrus Yarrow
blurb: Edmund Hartwell, a battlefield nurse keeping a ledger of the names officers omit, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. But when the bridge — the only road out — closes for the season, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must finish the work while the workshop still stands, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
